Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: No error E_ NOT_ OK: Checking of remote sleep indication bits has failed Description Check if remote sleep indication takes place or not. Cave ats: Udp Nm is initialized correctly. Configuration: Optional (only available if Udp Nm Remote Sleep Ind Enabled == true) Available via Udp Nm.h
